summary: rivervale/Hibbs_Rootenpaw (quests.id 14203) and rivervale/Beek_Guinders (quests.id 16326): remove the dead [trades] link from each Tattered Note welcome. Before: both welcomes end with a sentence offering a [trades] say_link, and neither maintained script has a findi("trades") handler, so the link does nothing. After: Hibbs's welcome ends at the P99 line "...it'll help keep you dry during the wet months." followed by the existing Reebo guidance; Beek's welcome ends "...please make sure that you see Thekela Meepup." Rewards, faction, and other dialogue are unchanged. Validation: static repro, check-proposal, npm test and npm run validate. Not runtime tested.

evidence.note: Offline page reference/p99-wiki/raw-pages/newbie-quest-halfling-druid-efd00aa6a7.wiki line 37: Hibbs's starting-note text ends "Here's your guild tunic, it'll help keep you dry during the wet months." with no [trades] sentence.

Ledger reference/server/internal/quest/content_exclusions.json line 19409 (Hibbs): "Local text includes additional IdleQuest guidance after the P99 starting-note completion line." The Reebo guidance is kept. sources/projecteq/rivervale/Beek_Guinders.lua line 21 has the findi("trades") branch that the maintained override dropped.
